title: Weather, Water, and Work: Climatic Water Variability and Labor Market Outcomes in Sub-Saharan Africa
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Vulnerability to climate change and water scarcity is increasing globally. How this affects individual employment outcomes is still not well understood. Using survey data collected from approximately half a million individuals across Sub-Saharan Africa over from 2005 to 2018, this paper examines the causal relationship between water availability and labor market outcomes. It combines georeferenced household survey data with a drought index that captures the exogenous effects of both rainfall and temperature on water availability. The findings suggest that extremely dry periods decrease employment by 2.5 percentage points on average, and wet periods with an abundance of soil moisture (not flooding) increase employment by 4 percentage points. The negative effects of dry shocks are larger in rural, poorer, and agriculture-dependent areas and for individuals who hold low-skilled jobs or work as farmers. Moreover, the paper finds that the burden of dry shocks disproportionately falls on women, while the benefits of wet shocks accrue more to men. The presence of irrigation infrastructure and the historical evolution of local livelihood strategies—historical mode of subsistence—partly mediate the impacts of water shocks.
abstract_zh: 气候变化和水资源短缺的脆弱性在全球范围内日益加剧。这如何影响个人的就业结果，目前仍不甚清楚。本文利用2005至2018年间撒哈拉以南非洲约50万名个体的调查数据，考察水资源可用性与劳动力市场结果之间的因果关系。研究将具有地理参照的住户调查数据与一个干旱指数相结合，该指数捕捉了降雨和温度对水资源可用性的外生影响。研究发现，极端干燥时期平均使就业率下降2.5个百分点，而土壤水分充足（但不是洪涝）的湿润时期则使就业率上升4个百分点。干燥冲击的负面影响在农村地区、较贫困地区以及依赖农业的地区更大，对从事低技能工作或从事农业的人群影响也更大。此外，研究发现干燥冲击的负担不成比例地落在妇女身上，而湿润冲击的好处则更多地惠及男性。灌溉基础设施的存在以及当地生计策略的历史演变（即历史生计模式）部分地调节了水冲击的影响。

title: Understanding the challenge of decoupling transport-related CO2 emissions from economic growth in developing countries
venue: World Development Sustainability
abstract: The transition to net zero requires full decarbonization of the transport sector, currently one of the leading sources of emissions globally. Transport-related carbon emissions are growing fastest in the developing world. This makes it particularly critical to understand whether low- and middle-income countries are making progress towards decoupling transport sector emissions from economic growth, as well as the extent to which their current emissions trajectory is being shaped by structural factors versus more amenable policy choices. This paper assembles and analyzes a comprehensive dataset on transport-related emissions with uniquely wide coverage of developing countries. The paper employs the Tapio decoupling model to demonstrate that only 36 percent of developing countries achieved (mainly relative) decoupling for transport-related carbon emissions over the period 1990-2018, compared to 70 percent of high-income countries. To shed light on the factors driving transport-related carbon emissions, the paper conducts both index-decomposition and econometric analysis. Index decomposition reveals that there have been only relatively modest reductions in the transport emissions intensity of GDP since 1990, and that these have not been large enough to offset economic growth in middle-income countries and demographic growth in low-income countries. Regression analysis further shows that urbanization and industrialization are important correlates of transport-related emissions, while the correlation of policy choices with reduced emissions is rather weak. Overall, developing countries are lagging-behind in the decoupling of transport-related emissions, and accelerating progress will be particularly challenging due to the very low baseline of transport emissions per capita, and the strong influence of structural factors on emissions trajectories.
abstract_zh: 实现净零排放需要交通部门完全脱碳，而交通部门目前是全球主要排放源之一。与交通相关的碳排放在发展中国家增长最快。因此，理解低收入和中等收入国家是否正在朝着交通部门排放与经济增长脱钩的方向取得进展，以及其当前排放轨迹在多大程度上受结构性因素而非较易调整的政策选择的影响，显得尤为关键。本文汇集并分析了一个综合数据集，其对发展中国家的覆盖范围独一无二。本文采用Tapio脱钩模型，表明在1990至2018年间，只有36%的发展中国家实现了（主要为相对）脱钩，而高收入国家的这一比例为70%。为揭示驱动交通相关碳排放的因素，本文同时进行了指数分解分析和计量经济分析。指数分解表明，自1990年以来，GDP的交通排放强度只有相对温和的下降，且这一下降幅度不足以抵消中等收入国家的经济增长以及低收入国家的人口增长。回归分析进一步表明，城市化和工业化是交通相关排放的重要相关因素，而政策选择与排放减少之间的相关性相当微弱。总体而言，发展中国家在交通排放脱钩方面落后，而且由于交通排放的人均基线非常低，以及结构性因素对排放轨迹的强烈影响，加快进展将尤其具有挑战性。

title: The Role of Government in the Market for Electric Vehicles: Evidence from China
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
abstract: To promote the development and diffusion of electric vehicles, central and local governments in many countries have adopted various incentive programs. This study examines the policy and market drivers behind the rapid development of the electric vehicle market in China, by far the largest one in the world. The analysis is based on the most comprehensive data on electric vehicle sales, local and central government incentive programs, and charging stations in 150 cities from 2015 to 2018. The study addresses the potential endogeneity of key variables, such as local policies and charging infrastructure, using the border regression design and instrumental variable method. The analysis shows that central and local subsidies accounted for over half of the electric vehicles sold during the data period. Investment in charging infrastructure is much more cost-effective than consumer purchase subsidies. In addition, the policy that merely provided electric vehicles a distinctively license plate was strikingly effective. These findings demonstrate the varying efficacy across policy instruments and highlight the critical role of government in promoting fuel-saving technologies.
abstract_zh: 为促进电动汽车的发展与普及，许多国家的中央政府和地方政府都采取了各种激励计划。本研究考察了中国电动汽车市场迅速发展背后的政策与市场驱动因素，中国是世界上规模最大的电动汽车市场。分析基于2015至2018年间150个城市中关于电动汽车销售、地方及中央政府激励计划以及充电站的最为全面的数据。研究采用边界回归设计和工具变量法，处理地方政策与充电基础设施等关键变量的内生性问题。分析表明，在数据期间，中央和地方补贴占所售电动汽车的一半以上。与消费者购车补贴相比，充电基础设施投资的成本效益要高得多。此外，仅为电动汽车提供专属车牌的政策效果显著。这些发现表明不同政策工具的效力存在差异，并凸显了政府在推广节油技术方面的关键作用。

title: Roads, Electricity, and Jobs: Evidence of Infrastructure Complementarity in Sub-Saharan Africa
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Evidence for road expansion and electrification as drivers of job creation is limited and mixed, with most studies having considered either one or the other and only in isolation. This paper studies complementarities between these infrastructures using data collected during the past two decades in 27 countries of sub-Saharan Africa. Exploiting the exogenous location of ancestral ethnic homelands, a new instrumental variable is created for road accessibility, inspired by post-independence leaders' agenda of building roads to extend authority over the entire expanse of their country and to promote nation-building. Topography and lightning strike ---a key source of damage to electric lines and disruption of service---are used to instrument electricity supply. The paper finds positive and significant effects on employment from enhancing proximity to roads and electric grids. Moreover, the interaction of the two enhances the effects, making them complementary investments. We also document significant heterogeneities in the positive impacts of both individual and bundled investments, with differences between men and women, workers of various ages, and countries at different stages of development. In urban areas, better access to roads and electricity promotes all types of employment. In rural areas, greater access induces a transition from low- to high-skilled occupations. These differential effects suggest that the structural transformation brought about by road and electricity expansion is primarily a rural phenomenon.
abstract_zh: 关于道路扩张和电气化作为创造就业驱动力的证据有限且结论不一，大多数研究只考察了其中一项，而且仅是孤立地进行考察。本文利用过去二十年间在27个撒哈拉以南非洲国家收集的数据，研究这些基础设施之间的互补性。利用祖先族群家园的外生位置，我们构建了道路可达性的新工具变量，其灵感来自独立后领导人的议程，即修建道路以将权威延伸至国家的每一寸土地，并促进国家建设。地形和雷击（雷击是输电线路损坏和服务中断的主要原因）被用作电力供应的工具变量。本文发现，提高与道路和电网的邻近程度对就业具有正向且显著的影响。此外，两者的交互作用增强了这些效应，使二者成为互补性投资。我们还记录了单独投资和捆绑投资的正向影响在男女之间、不同年龄劳动者之间以及处于不同发展阶段的国家之间存在显著的异质性。在城市地区，更好的道路和电力可达性促进了各类就业。在农村地区，更高的可达性促使劳动力从低技能职业向高技能职业转变。这些差异化效应表明，道路和电力扩张所带来的结构转型主要是一种农村现象。

title: The Global Diffusion of Electric Vehicles: Lessons from the First Decade
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Electrifying the transportation sector is key to reaching the goal of carbon neutrality. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the diffusion of passenger electric vehicles based on detailed data on model-level electrical vehicle sales across the world from 2013 to 2020. The analysis shows that the highly uneven electrical vehicle penetration across countries is partly driven by cross-country variation in incentives and especially in the availability of charging infrastructure. Investment in charging infrastructure would have been much more cost-effective than consumer purchase subsidies in promoting electrical vehicle adoption. This finding highlights the importance of expanding charging infrastructure in the next phase of deeper electrical vehicle diffusion.
abstract_zh: 推动交通部门电动化是实现碳中和目标的关键。本文基于2013至2020年全球车型级电动汽车销售的详细数据，对乘用电动汽车的扩散进行了全面分析。分析表明，各国电动汽车渗透率的高度不均衡，部分是由于各国激励政策的差异，尤其是充电基础设施可用性的差异。与消费者购车补贴相比，投资充电基础设施在促进电动汽车普及方面的成本效益要高得多。这一发现凸显了在电动汽车更深层次扩散的下一阶段扩大充电基础设施的重要性。

title: Transportation and the Environment: A Review of Empirical Literature
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: In urban areas around the world, increasing motorization and growing travel demand make theurban transportation sector an ever-greater contributor to local air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. Thesituation is particularly acute in developing countries, where growing metropolitan regions suffer some of theworld’s highest levels of air pollution. Policies that seek to develop and manage this transportation sector—to meetrising demand linked to economic growth and safeguard the environment and human health—have had strikingly differentresults, with some inadvertently exacerbating the traffic and pollution they seek to mitigate. This paper provides anoverview of the findings of the recent literature on the impacts of a host of urban transportation policies used indeveloped and developing country settings. The paper identifies research challenges and future areas of study oftransportation policies, which can have important, long-lasting impacts on urban life and global climate change.
abstract_zh: 在世界各地的城市地区，机动化程度不断提高，出行需求持续增长，使城市交通部门成为地方空气污染和温室气体排放日益重要的来源。在发展中国家，这一情况尤为严峻，那里快速发展的大都市区承受着世界上最高的空气污染水平。为满足经济增长带来的出行需求，同时保护环境和人类健康，各类交通发展与管理政策取得了截然不同的效果，其中一些政策无意中加剧了本欲缓解的交通拥堵和污染。本文概述了近期文献中关于发达国家和发展中国家一系列城市交通政策影响的研究发现。本文指出了交通政策研究的挑战和未来研究方向，这些政策可能对城市生活和全球气候变化产生重要而持久的影响。

title: Does energy efficiency promote economic growth? Evidence from a multicountry and multisectoral panel dataset
venue: Energy Economics
abstract: We examine the causal relationship between energy efficiency and economic growth based on panel data for 56 high- and middle-income economies from 1978 to 2012. Using a panel vector autoregression approach, we find evidence of a long-run Granger causality from economic growth to lower energy intensity for all economies. We also find evidence of long-run bidirectional causality between lower energy intensity and higher economic growth for middle-income economies. This finding suggests that beyond climate benefits, middle-income economies may also earn an extra growth dividend from energy efficiency measures.
abstract_zh: 我们利用56个中高收入经济体1978至2012年的面板数据，考察能源效率与经济增长之间的因果关系。采用面板向量自回归方法，我们发现所有经济体都存在从经济增长到能源强度下降的长期格兰杰因果关系。我们还发现，对于中等收入经济体而言，能源强度下降与经济增长提高之间存在长期双向因果关系。这一发现表明，除了气候效益之外，中等收入经济体还可能从能源效率措施中获得额外的增长红利。

title: Energy prices and international trade: incorporating input-output linkages
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper examines the effect of energy costs on industry export competitiveness. Most studies in the literature use direct energy consumption (energy consumption at the final stage of production) and domestic energy prices to compute energy costs faced by domestic industries. Using multi-country input-output information, this study measures the effect of aggregate energy costs on export performance, where aggregate energy costs include not only direct energy costs, but also indirect energy costs passed on through the upstream supply chain. This study develops a theoretical trade model that incorporates tradable intermediate goods to inform its empirical strategy. It then estimates a reduced-form model using a panel data for 10 manufacturing sectors in 43 countries from 1991 to 2012. The analysis finds that ignoring input-output relationships can lead to significant over- or underestimates of the effect of energy price shocks on exports, depending on intermediate factor intensities and trade relationships. Using estimated trade elasticities, the study simulates the economic consequences of energy cross-subsidies and carbon taxes. The results show that energy cross-subsidies that raise energy tariffs on industry to support lower rates for households and farmers in India could reduce the country's net manufacturing exports by $6.1 billion a year. Similarly, a carbon tax that unilaterally increases energy prices by 10 percent in the European Union could reduce European Union-wide net manufacturing exports by 1.9 percent annually.
abstract_zh: 本文考察能源成本对行业出口竞争力的影响。文献中的大多数研究使用直接能源消费（生产最终阶段的能源消费）和国内能源价格来计算国内行业所面临的能源成本。本研究利用多国投入产出信息，衡量综合能源成本对出口绩效的影响，其中综合能源成本不仅包括直接能源成本，也包括通过上游供应链传导的间接能源成本。本研究构建了一个纳入可贸易中间品的理论贸易模型，以指导其实证策略。随后，我们利用1991至2012年43个国家10个制造业部门的面板数据，估计了一个简化形式模型。分析发现，忽略投入产出关系可能导致对能源价格冲击对出口影响的显著高估或低估，这取决于中间要素密集度和贸易关系。利用估计的贸易弹性，本研究模拟了能源交叉补贴和碳税的经济后果。结果表明，印度若通过提高工业能源电价来支持家庭和农民享受较低电价的能源交叉补贴，每年可能使其制造业净出口减少61亿美元。同样，若欧盟单方面将能源价格提高10%的碳税，可能使欧盟整体制造业净出口每年减少1.9%。

title: Rate of return regulation and emission permits trading under uncertainty
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper analyzes the dynamic effects of rate-of-return regulation on firms? emissions compliance behavior when the price of emissions permits is uncertain. The paper shows that uncertainty regarding the price of permits would motivate a regulated firm to adopt a more self-sufficient strategy and would reduce the cost-effectiveness of emission allowance trading. When allowance transactions are treated as capital investments, uncertainty could reverse the classic Averch-Johnson effect, so that a regulated firm would purchase fewer permits in the ex ante period than its unregulated counterpart. These results are driven by the asymmetric impact of a price change on the expected marginal value of allowances under rate-of-return regulation. A wider variation in the permit price and a decline in the regulated rate of return would amplify the asymmetry. These results have implications for the efficiency of the proposed global carbon trading system.
abstract_zh: 本文分析在排放许可价格存在不确定性的情况下，投资回报率监管对企业排放合规行为的动态影响。研究表明，许可价格的不确定性会促使受监管企业采取更为自给自足的策略，并会降低排放配额交易的成本效益。当配额交易被视为资本投资时，不确定性可能扭转经典的阿弗—约翰逊效应，使受监管企业在事前购买的许可少于未受监管的同类企业。这些结果源于投资回报率监管下价格变化对配额预期边际价值的非对称影响。许可价格波动幅度越大，受监管投资回报率越低，这种非对称性就越强。这些结果对拟议中的全球碳交易体系的效率具有启示意义。

title: Firm competitiveness and the European Union emissions trading scheme
venue: Energy Policy
abstract: The European Union Emissions Trading Scheme is the first international cap-and-trade program for CO2 and the largest carbon pricing regime in the world. A principle concern over the Emissions Trading Scheme is the potential impact on the competitiveness of industry. Using a panel of 5,873 firms in 10 European countries during 2001-2009, this paper seeks to assess the impact of the carbon regulation on three variables through which the effects on firm competitiveness may manifest - unit material costs, employment and revenue. Our analysis focuses on three most polluting industries covered under the program- power, cement, and iron and steel. Empirical results indicate that the emissions trading program had different impacts across these three sectors. While no impacts are found on any of the three variables in cement and iron and steel industries, our analysis suggests a positive effect on both material costs and revenue: the effect on material costs likely reflects fuel-switching to reduce CO2 emissions while that on revenue may partly due to cost pass-through to consumers in a market less exposed to competition outside EU. Overall our findings do not substantiate concerns over carbon leakage, job loss and industry competitiveness at least during the study period.
abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系是世界上第一个针对二氧化碳的国际总量控制与交易计划，也是全球最大的碳定价制度。对欧盟排放交易体系的一个主要关注点，是其对产业竞争力的潜在影响。本文利用2001至2009年间10个欧洲国家5,873家企业的面板数据，评估碳监管对三个可能体现企业竞争力影响的变量的影响，即单位材料成本、就业和收入。我们的分析聚焦于该计划所覆盖的三个污染最严重的行业：电力、水泥以及钢铁。实证结果表明，排放交易计划对这三个行业的影响各不相同。虽然在水泥和钢铁行业未发现这三个变量受到任何影响，但我们的分析表明，其对材料成本和收入均有正向影响：材料成本的影响可能反映了为减少二氧化碳排放而进行的燃料转换，而收入的影响可能部分源于成本向消费者的转嫁，这些消费者所处的市场较少受到欧盟以外竞争的影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果未能证实在研究期间内对碳泄漏、失业和产业竞争力的担忧。

title: The energy transition of the transition economies: An empirical analysis
venue: Energy Economics
abstract: The aggregate manufacturing energy intensity of 28 countries in Eastern Europe and Central Asia had declined by 35 percent during 1998-2008. This study reveals strong evidence of convergence: less efficient countries improved more rapidly and the cross-country variance in energy productivity narrowed over time. An index decomposition analysis indicates that energy intensities declined largely because of more efficient energy use rather than shifts from energy intensive to less intensive manufacturing activities. Income growth and energy price increases were the main drivers of the convergence. They dominated the impact of trade, which led to specialization in energy intensive industries.
abstract_zh: 1998至2008年间，东欧和中亚28个国家的制造业总体能源强度下降了35%。本研究揭示了明显的收敛证据：效率较低的国家改善得更快，跨国能源生产率的方差随时间推移而缩小。指数分解分析表明，能源强度的下降主要源于能源利用效率的提高，而非从能源密集型制造活动向非能源密集型制造活动的转移。收入增长和能源价格上涨是收敛的主要驱动因素。它们的作用超过了贸易的影响，而贸易导致了在能源密集型行业中的专业化。

title: How fit are feed-in tariff policies? evidence from the European wind market

title: Climate change policies and employment in Eastern Europe and Central Asia
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper analyzes the differential impact of climate change policies on employment in Eastern Europe and Central Asia. In particular, the paper examines (i) how vulnerable labor markets are in Eastern European and Central Asian countries to future carbon regulation, and (ii) what countries can do to mitigate some of the potential negative effects of these regulatory changes on employment. In many aspects, the nature of the shock associated with climate regulation is similar to that associated with an increase in energy prices. Constraints on carbon emissions put a price on climate-damaging activities and make hydrocarbon-based energy production and consumption more expensive. As a result, firms in energy-intensive industries may react to higher energy prices by reducing production, which in turn would lead to lower employment. In the presence of frictions in labor markets, these sector shifts will cause resources to be unemployed, at least in the short term. Using principal component analysis, the paper finds that Eastern European and Central Asian countries vary greatly in their vulnerability and adaptability of employment to carbon regulation. Since the economy takes time to adjust, policy-makers will need to ensure that the incentives are there for new firms to emerge and employ workers, and that workers have the skills to respond to that demand. Moreover, governments have a role to play in ensuring that workers that are displaced have a proper safety net that will not only help in protecting their welfare, but will also allow workers to make more efficient labor market transitions.
abstract_zh: 本文分析气候变化政策对东欧和中亚就业的差异化影响。具体而言，本文考察了（i）东欧和中亚国家的劳动力市场在多大程度上易受未来碳监管的影响，以及（ii）各国可以采取哪些措施来减轻这些监管变化对就业的一些潜在负面影响。在许多方面，气候监管所带来的冲击性质与能源价格上涨所带来的冲击相似。碳排放限制为气候破坏性活动赋予了价格，并使基于碳氢化合物的能源生产和消费变得更加昂贵。因此，能源密集型行业的企业可能会因能源价格上涨而减少生产，进而导致就业下降。在劳动力市场存在摩擦的情况下，这些部门的转移将导致资源至少在短期内处于失业状态。利用主成分分析，本文发现东欧和中亚国家对碳监管的劳动力市场脆弱性和就业适应能力差异很大。由于经济调整需要时间，政策制定者需要确保有相应激励，使新企业得以产生并雇用工人，同时确保工人具备应对这一需求的技能。此外，政府有责任确保失业工人获得适当的安全网，这不仅有助于保障其福利，也能使工人更有效地实现劳动力市场转换。

title: Distributional impact analysis of the energy price reform in Turkey
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: A pricing reform in Turkey increased the residential electricity tariff by more than 50 percent in 2008. The reform, aimed at encouraging energy efficiency and private investment, sparked considerable policy debate about its potential impact on household welfare. This paper estimates a short-run residential electricity demand function for evaluating the distributional consequences of the tariff reform. The model allows heterogeneity in household price sensitivities and is estimated using a national sample of 18,671 Turkish households. The model also addresses the common problem of missing data in survey research. The study reveals a highly skewed distribution of price elasticities in the population, with rich households three times more responsive in adjusting consumption to price changes than the poor. This is most likely because the poor are close to their minimum electricity consumption levels and have fewer coping options. In addition, the welfare loss of the poorest quintile -- measured by the consumer surplus change as a percentage of income -- is 2.9 times of that of the wealthiest.
abstract_zh: 土耳其于2008年进行的一项定价改革，使居民电价上涨超过50%。该改革旨在鼓励能源效率和私人投资，并引发了关于其对家庭福利潜在影响的大量政策讨论。本文估计了一个短期居民电力需求函数，以评估电价改革的分配后果。该模型允许家庭价格敏感性存在异质性，并利用一个全国性的18,671户土耳其家庭样本进行估计。该模型还解决了调查研究中普遍存在的数据缺失问题。研究揭示了人口中价格弹性的高度偏态分布：富裕家庭在根据价格变化调整消费方面的反应程度是贫困家庭的三倍。这很可能是因为贫困家庭接近其最低电力消费水平，且应对选择较少。此外，最贫穷五分位组的福利损失（以消费者剩余变化占收入的百分比衡量）是最富裕群体的2.9倍。
